_comment: Critic-owned. The builder must not edit this file or critic.mjs. Positions are feet in the plaza frame (Houston/Main origin, +X east, +Z south, Y up). Expected positions are documented visual estimates, not survey-calibrated values.

hookContract._comment: When the trajectory page URL contains critic=1, the 3D scene must expose window.__plazaCritic = { view, eye:[x,y,z], target:[x,y,z], renders, objects: { <name>: { center:[x,y,z], min:[x,y,z], max:[x,y,z] } } } updated after every view change and render. Object names come from THREE.Object3D.name.

tsbd-sniper-window._comment: SE-corner sixth-floor bay on the south facade: easternmost of 8 bays (x = -120 + 7.5 * 12.5), sixth-floor row of the 7-row grid (y = 9 + 5 * 78/7), south face z = -275.

zapruder-pedestal._comment: Concrete pedestal at the west end of the north pergola, on the Elm Street side, estimated from period photographs. Horizontal check only for center; height is checked against local ground.

stockade-fence._comment: Existing picket stockade behind the north pergola (x -360..-200, z about -245..-257).

eyeOutsideFacadeZ._comment: eye must sit on or just outside the south face (z from -275 to -268) so the solid wall does not block the view

knoll._comment: Existing north pergola vicinity view must stay where #151 put it.
